messages:
maria_support: Hey team — Acme reported persistent 429s on their Dedicated pool (pool-id: dp-42) after migrating traffic yesterday. They say latency also spiked to 800-1200ms. Sample curl attached.

maria_support: curl response: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Headers: x-rate-limit-limit: 50 x-rate-limit-remaining: 0 x-request-id: r-9f3a
Body: {"error":"rate_limited"}

maria_support: tenant: acme-tenant-7, customer ticket #12345. They expected 500 RPS capacity when they bought Reserved plan. On our console the tenant quota looks like 50 RPS. I'm escalating — suspect quota wiring issue during plan migration.

lee_oncall: Thanks Maria. Repro steps? Can you share a short load pattern that hits the issue?

maria_support: Steps I ran in staging to reproduce: 1) set tenant header X-Tenant: acme-tenant-7 2) POST /v1/generate with concurrency 60, request size ~ 80 tokens 3) observe 429s after ~30s. I can drop the exact k6 script in the thread.

sam_infra: Copy of what storage/admin shows: GET /admin/dedicated/pools/dp-42/tenants/acme-tenant-7 returns {
  "rate_unit": "rps",
  "limit": 50,
  "source": "imported_plan_v2"
}
Looks like plan migration left a low limit. Autoscaler isn't adding GPUs because overall pool util is <75% — throttling is per-tenant so autoscale doesn't react.

maria_support: That matches customer report — they saw bursts get throttled while other tenants stayed fine (noisy neighbor behaviour but quota-based).

eva_eng: Agile note: Our routing fallback to compatible model variant doesn't trigger because we return 429 before model routing layer. We should consider an earlier soft-queue/fallback when tenant quota is hit. Filing an RFC later.

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2023-789 — assigned to sam_infra, priority P2.

sam_infra: Immediate mitigation options:
- Temporarily raise tenant limit to 600 RPS via admin override: PATCH /admin/tenants/acme-tenant-7 {limit:600,source:"ops-override"}
- Create a temporary routing rule to send acme traffic to dedicated-pool-b (if available)
Both require ops approval.

lee_oncall: Action plan: 1) Sam to apply ops-override and monitor for 15m 2) I'll run the k6 load script to validate 3) Maria to update customer with ETA 4) Eva to track longer-term fallback work.

sam_infra: Applying override now. Will post result.

sam_infra: PATCH result: 200 OK, new tenant limit: 600, source: ops-override. Starting 5m soak.

lee_oncall: Running quick run — concurrency 120, 2s ramp, 5m. Will report latency and 429 counts.

lee_oncall: After 6m soak: no 429s observed, p50 latency ~210ms, p95 ~480ms. Pool GPU util rose from 18% -> 47% during traffic spike.

maria_support: Customer notified: we applied temporary override and are monitoring. Escalation ticket updated. They asked for permanent fix and audit of migration scripts.

eva_eng: I'll open a GH issue to add a migration-time assertion to ensure tenant quota mapping matches plan tier. Also adding alert: per-tenant throttling > 5% of requests for 5m -> pager.

tim_sales: Heads up — Acme asked for credit for the 3 hours of degraded experience. Please include charge impact estimate in ticket.

sam_infra: Noted. I've added ops changelog entry and will revert override after customer confirms plan/capacity or after we roll a proper migration fix.

maria_support: Thanks all. Next updates in 30m or on channel.
